subtasks.title: Add task UUID display to TaskDetail header
subtasks.description: In `TaskDetail.tsx`, add a small monospace label showing `task.id` in the header area, positioned between the breadcrumb/title section and the description. Style it with `text-slate-500 text-xs font-mono` for a subtle, copyable display. Ensure it renders in both normal and readonly modes.
acceptance_criteria: UUID is visible in task detail header
UUID shows in readonly mode too
